articles.title: BTS Won’t Submit Comeback Album for Consideration at 2027 Grammys - Rolling Stone
articles.description: BTS won't submit their comeback album 'Arirang' for consideration at the 2027 Grammy Awards following the addition of an Asian pop-specific category.
